messages:
chris-finance: Heads up  small but noisy issue in today's finalize: a few EU customers missing prorated reserved compute line; others got two finalized invoices with slightly different totals. seeing reconciliation variance ~€1.2k across the cohort.

yuna-eng: example? invoice id + customer please.

chris-finance: INV-2024-4789 / cust-eu-77. Payments UI shows INV-2024-4789 (no prorate line) and INV-2024-4789-2 (has prorate but different total).

payments-bot: finalize_run:202405_eu status=SUCCESS 2481230010 invoices_finalized=14320 duplicates_detected=9

billing-bot: fx-service call returned rate=1.0812 for EUR->USD at 2481229988

olga-support: tickets coming in. two customers already paid the higher amount. need comms + credits.

yuna-eng: quick triage: prorate calculation uses subscription_change_timestamp in customer tz. our proration window code assumed UTC day boundaries; a recent timezone normalization PR changed how we compute local day start for CET/CEST. when subscription change happens near DST boundary we sometimes compute 0 days prorated and omit the line.

yuna-eng: second issue: currency conversion path is non-deterministic under retries. if fx-service 500s during finalize we retry and get a slightly different rate; renderer persisted whichever rate was used per worker. that explains duplicate invoices with small diffs.

chris-finance: any reproducer?

yuna-eng: reproducer snippet:
```
# pseudo
local_day = start_of_day(order.sub_change_ts, tz=customer.tz)  # bug: tz normalization uses naive UTC
prorate_days = (billing_cycle_end - local_day).days
if prorate_days == 0:
  # omit prorate line
```

yuna-eng: and fx race:
```
rate = fx.get_rate('EUR','USD') # sometimes 500 -> retry -> new_rate
total = round(subtotal * rate, 2)
emit_invoice(total, rate)
```

chris-finance: ops/infra - any deployments around the timezone-normalization PR?

billing-bot: deploy billing-renderer:v3.20 completed 2481229950 by ci-pipeline (includes tz-normalize PR)

olga-support: prioritizing customers who paid. we'll hold outbound messages until finance approves comms.

yuna-eng: mitigation steps: 1) patch proration to use aware datetime with customer's tz and defensive min_days=1 for same-day changes 2) make fx-service client cache recent rate for 5s and make retries reuse cached rate; add idempotency key so finalize retries don't create new invoice ids.

chris-finance: sounds good. pause EU payout batch and flag affected accounts.

payments-bot: repair_job queued by yuna-eng at 2481230400 action=dedupe_and_recompute count=9

yuna-eng: patch pushed 2481230580: proration fix + fx client change + idempotency lock. running re-finalize for affected invoices now.

billing-bot: refinalize complete at 2481230760 status=SUCCESS duplicates_voided=9 credits_issued=6 refunds_initiated=2

chris-finance: verified diffs for top-5 affected customers; prorate lines now present and totals match ledger. preparing finance note and customer outreach.

olga-support: comms template ready: "We identified duplicate invoices and missing prorated adjustments for a small set of customers. We have corrected your invoice and issued credits where needed. No action required." sending to finance for signoff.

cfo: please include a short postmortem + action items: tz test coverage, fx-client retry semantics, and finalize dedupe metric.

yuna-eng: will add unit tests for DST boundary cases and an alert if finalize_duplicate_rate > 0 for any batch. leaving a small log for the postmortem: 
```
ERROR proration: computed prorate_days=0 for cust-eu-77 at 2481229999 (expected 1)
WARN fx-client: retry returned different rate 1.0812 -> 1.0820 for invoice INV-2024-4789 at 2481230021
```

chris-finance: creating incident ticket and attaching affected invoice ids + diffs. thanks all. closing thread for now.
